title: Price-snapshot store — opening and closing numbers for every market we originate

contract.origination_order: side first, then total, then moneyline (S3)
contract.our_line: our own originated number — computed by the repo model, always recorded
contract.market_line: the market's number at that stage — recorded only from an official source; blank and flagged today because no league or club source publishes prices (Q-02)
contract.difference: fair line minus market line — must stay blank while market_line is blank; never derived from a third-party number
contract.capture_rule: a stage not captured in time keeps its status and an empty value; it is never back-filled from the other stage
contract.mirror_rule: third-party prices live only in the mirror_* columns, each row carrying its verification state and the sha256 of the pinned file it was read from; they are never copied into market_line, and no opening value is back-filled from a closing file (price-data policy decision, 2026-11-17)

source.label: NFL.com Week 10 schedule (the games these markets are originated on)

price_provenance.policy: 2026-11-17: publish the mirror's numbers in labelled columns, never as an official price; keep opening blank until a licensed feed exists; state that a residual against an unverified price is not closing line value

note: This store is append-ready: tools/build_snapshots.py regenerates it from the origination file, the closed results feed and the fingerprinted mirror. When an official price source is settled (Q-02), market_line and difference fill from recorded captures only; the mirror columns never migrate into them.
